name: CodeSystemOid
description: Mirrors the subset of mapping-engine's naming-systems.yaml (read by NamingSystemRegistry) that GetDiagnosis needs: patient-identifier OIDs and diagnosis code-system OIDs, as a real FHIR ConceptMap resource. Unlike NamingSystemRegistry.oidToUri(...), translate()'s own ConceptMap.group.unmapped mode can only fall back to a FIXED code, not a computed 'urn:oid:<oid>' string - so the urn:oid fallback for an OID NOT in this list is still built explicitly in the .map files via FHIRPath string concatenation, with a comment at each use site. See malac-hd-evaluation.md.
